# Contributing and review rules (checklist #100)

* Every change: tests for success and failure paths; `tools/ci.sh` green; no new third-party runtime dependency without security review.
* Security review is mandatory when touching `runtime/identity.py`, `authz.py`, `vault.py`, `audit.py`, `service.py`, `schemas/`, `deploy/vault/`.
* CODEOWNERS approval required; protected branch `main` (no force-push, linear history, required status `ci`); release tags `v*` protected, created only by the release authority.
* Generated files (`schemas/*.json`, `COMPONENT_STATUS.json`, `TRACEABILITY.json`, `evidence/`) are regenerated by tools, never hand-edited; generated files must not embed host paths or interpreter versions.
* Secrets: never commit credentials; `tools/secret_scan.py` runs in CI; test canaries are synthetic and allow-listed with justification.
